task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Your first objective is to open the portal in the bar. After that, go to the south. And then, recover the passkey from the plate inside the dish-pit. If you can get your hands on the passkey, unlock the gateway with the passkey. Then, ensure that the gateway inside the dish-pit is open. After that, go south. And then, try to take a trip west. And then, take a trip west. If you can get through with that, make an attempt to venture west. Once you accomplish that, take a trip north. And then, make an effort to go east. Then, lift the sandwich from the floor of the parlor. And if you do that, you're the winner!
